handover_protocol.new_chat_start: Read CURRENT first, then fresh-reconcile live GitHub main, open PRs, relevant branches and CI before acting. Live GitHub outranks this snapshot.

lane.name: Culinary App / Culinary Lab — Corpus Scale / 170k No-Billing-Authorization Readiness with additive YouTube Culinary Discovery child programme
lane.rule: Do not perform ordinary Culinary Brain / Knowledge Core implementation from this lane.
lane.knowledge_core_boundary: Knowledge Core remains read-only/reconciliation from this lane and must never become a private browser/runtime dependency.
lane.nutrition_boundary: Nutrition remains an independent resumable lane and must not be overwritten or weakened by corpus-scale, auth or YouTube-discovery work.

operating_contract.autonomy: Proceed autonomously through technically resolvable repository work after fresh reconciliation. Stop only for genuine human/security/cost gates, unrecoverable errors, terminal material results or continuation boundaries.
operating_contract.user_facing_rule: No routine narration outside those gates/results.
operating_contract.fresh_reconciliation: Before every meaningful write or merge, fresh-reconcile main, open PRs, relevant branches, changed files, CI and concurrent work.
operating_contract.actions_authority: Normal repository CI, browser acceptance, roadmap-required benchmark workflows, path-scoped validation and technically necessary ordinary reruns are standing-preauthorized by AGENTS.md.
operating_contract.cost_boundary: Hard no-billing-authorization constraint: do not activate or accept any product/subscription whose setup authorizes a payment method to be charged for usage beyond free limits. No paid Cloudflare plan, paid API, paid corpus licence or recurring infrastructure cost is authorized.
operating_contract.external_setup_gate_rule: Every future human provisioning step must terminate as FREE_NO_BILLING_AUTHORIZATION_CONFIRMED, BILLING_OR_OVERAGE_AUTHORIZATION_PRESENT, or AMBIGUOUS. Only FREE_NO_BILLING_AUTHORIZATION_CONFIRMED may proceed.

step_7a.worker_cpu_boundary: Actual Workers Free CPU remains a mandatory later protected canary gate; GitHub wall-clock proxy is advisory only.

current.name: STEP_7B_FREE_DEVELOPER_RESOURCE_PROVISIONING_CHECK
current.purpose: Determine whether D1 Free can be created/used while remaining on Workers Free without accepting any checkout, subscription, payment authorization or overage authorization.
current.first_action_only: Open Cloudflare Dashboard -> Storage & databases -> D1 SQLite Database. Do not create anything yet if the next screen contains billing/subscription/payment/overage language; paste the screen back for inspection.
current.hard_stop: Do not accept any checkout or subscription, even one showing $0, if it authorizes charges beyond included limits. Do not activate Zero Trust, R2 or Workers Paid.

yt_cul_5.binding_constraint: Independent Recipe-structured page reachability does not establish World Recipe Atlas family relevance; source diversity was also weak because all three confirmed pages came from one domain.

daily_discovery_roadmap.objective: After the relevance/source-diversity architecture passes, run one quota-aware bounded discovery cycle per YouTube quota day, accumulate policy-safe review evidence, apply queue backpressure and marginal-value stopping rules, and evaluate YT-CUL-6 readiness from canonical Knowledge Core outcomes rather than raw YouTube activity.
daily_discovery_roadmap.absolute_ceiling_rule: assigned Search daily limit minus five-call reserve
daily_discovery_roadmap.low_value_hold_rule: three consecutive active quota days with zero new ATLAS_RELEVANCE_REVIEW_READY packets after deduplication
daily_discovery_roadmap.yt_cul_6_readiness_rule: At least one programme-origin discovery must reach canonical Knowledge Core APP_AUTHORING_ELIGIBLE or then-current equivalent, using independent non-YouTube evidence with no unresolved rights/provenance/safety blocker, after YT-CUL-5R PASS and fresh app-side reconciliation.

next_phase.rule: Do not resume live Search until YT-CUL-5R passes. After PASS, recurring daily bounded Search is the intended programme path toward YT-CUL-6, with adaptive quota allocation, cumulative evidence, Knowledge Core review authority, review-backlog holds and low-marginal-value stopping rules.
